title: Portable Runtime API & Client Reconnection
required_previous_checkpoint: accepted 0.0.6 Runtime State & Event Foundation source tree
scope: Versioned platform-neutral HTTP/WebSocket Runtime API, race-safe runtime-id/event-cursor reconnect, snapshot reset semantics, bounded client backpressure, loopback-only exposure, and real TCP reconnect diagnostics without changing accepted voice behavior
focused_test_command: python -m unittest tests.unit.test_0_0_7_runtime_protocol tests.unit.test_0_0_7_runtime_settings tests.unit.test_0_0_7_runtime_event_stream tests.integration.test_0_0_7_runtime_api tests.unit.test_event_bus tests.integration.test_0_0_6_runtime_foundation -v
runtime_invariants: JarvisRuntime and Conversation Core remain server-owned across client disconnect/restart
a nonzero reconnect cursor is valid only with the matching runtime_id
subscription begins before reconnect snapshot capture to eliminate snapshot/listen races
history gaps, runtime changes, impossible cursors, replay overflow, and slow-client backpressure require explicit resynchronization
platform metadata is informational and never grants authority
0.0.7 unauthenticated API may bind only to loopback addresses
public runtime protocol contains JSON-safe values only and rejects opaque binary/native objects
known_limitations: authenticated LAN/WAN/mobile-to-desktop transport and device pairing are deferred
event replay is memory-only and resets with a new Core process/runtime_id
typed command submission through the Runtime API is deferred
tools, memory persistence, autonomous jobs, and durable redacted event storage are deferred
fuzzy wake-word correction such as Jervis to Jarvis is deferred
